steps.description:
The OR operator is used to check if at least one of two conditions is True. 



When either one or both conditions are True, the OR block will be True. Otherwise, it will be False.


Complete the condition of the following code so that a sound is played when ANY of the following is performed:
  1. Only Button at D18 is pressed.
  2. Only Button at D22 is pressed.
  3. Both Buttons at D18 and D22 are pressed.
